scope: Six upstream source-module experiments, NOT complete product acceptance or production integration

gaps: Lock fields are not persisted in JSON
Clear path calls a missing canvas.clearHistory API
Stale upstream results can be reused
No request-level result cache on rerun
Failed node remains running and sibling request can write late
Stop does not cancel in-flight requests
Older completion can overwrite newer output

invoke.probe: I09: empty-alpha active mask still has hasSelection=true; not enough contract evidence to label this a product bug

boundaries: Manual restage is not automatic retry
Stable key is not disk persistence
Content cache is not tenant isolation
Duplicate release callback can make counters negative

findings: Signing failure leaves raw storage path
Database error confused with absent kit
definePlugin does not validate or sandbox plugins
